scope: Exactly the 30 assigned logging/audit IDs; no runtime or shared ledger edits.

network_controls.transport: Own ScopedTransport extends offline FixtureTransport and adds production receipt scope from exact request; finite exact URL+method dispatch asserts HTTPS host/path and field masks; all native responses pass through real GCPCollector and evaluate_snapshot.

metric_schema.reviewed: Native metric ID, disabled default, descriptor type, bucketName route scope.

metrics_list.reviewed: GET project metrics and nextPageToken protocol.

alert_schema.reviewed: Read enabled must be explicit; validity marks a policy incapable of incident generation; conditions and selector filters.

channel_schema.reviewed: Explicit enabled is collected; UNVERIFIED denotes a channel requiring verification to function.

sink_schema.reviewed: Sink disabled, filter, exclusions, includeChildren and interceptChildren declarations.

routing.reviewed: Higher intercepting ancestor can divert project or descendant sink traffic; declaration is not delivery.

query.reviewed: Boolean precedence, NOT and restricted expressions must be honored; concrete-actor restrictions do not cover other principals.

project.reviewed: Native name is projects/numeric-number and projectId is the distinct user-assigned alias.

ancestry.reviewed: POST empty body; ancestor list starts with selected project and orders parents bottom to top.

policy.reviewed: POST with requestedPolicyVersion=3 returns whole Policy.

policy_schema.reviewed: auditConfigs and allServices categories are declaration evidence.

audit.reviewed: Inherited audit categories and exemptions participate in effective audit declaration.

entries.reviewed: POST resourceNames and filter delimit scoped window; native entries and pageToken.

transparency.reviewed: Logs describe eligible provider access; an empty window does not establish disabled configuration.

D01.title: Synthetic actor mistaken for universal event coverage
D01.observed: PASS: every synthetic event uses admin@example.com, although events by another principal are excluded.
D01.required_fix: Keep variable principal/severity fields unknown or prove structural coverage over variable dimensions; never conclude full coverage solely from matching concrete synthetic actor examples.

D02.title: Invalid alert policy counted as satisfying alert declaration
D02.observed: PASS although the API explicitly marks the policy invalid.
D02.required_fix: Reject policies with nonzero validity.code; malformed/denied validity remains UNKNOWN. The strict shared matcher already has this guard.

D03.title: Non-functioning unverified notification channel counted
D03.observed: PASS with the sole channel explicitly unverified.
D03.required_fix: Exclude UNVERIFIED channels from positive notifying chains, preserving a verified enabled sibling if present; unknown state must not imply verified delivery.

D04.title: Alert selector restricted to another project counted
D04.observed: PASS because metric.type substring linking ignores the foreign resource project restriction.
D04.required_fix: Parse Monitoring selector and bind project restrictions to the independently collected projectId/number aliases; do not certify by substring.

D05.title: Negated event-filter template counted by regex search
D05.observed: PASS although the metric excludes the reference events.
D05.required_fix: Use whole-expression equivalence/coverage proof, never an unanchored regex of the reference template; preserve UNKNOWN for unsupported expressions.

D06.title: Bucket-restricted metric counted without bucket routing proof
D06.observed: PASS despite missing evidence that the required entries reach the metric-owning bucket.
D06.required_fix: Return UNKNOWN/MANUAL for bucket-scoped metrics unless independently proven route coverage supports the check; the strict and claude2 families already refuse PASS.

D07.title: Access Transparency cannot pass for native numeric project name under ID scope
D07.observed: UNKNOWN project identity differs from scope despite exact native event and independently collected alias; numeric scope has a PASS proof.
D07.required_fix: Bind project name and selected ID via native projectId/name, then retain exact entry scope, identity, timestamps and complete-collection guards.
